translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Fioang Awewen Erhai Rhooapwut Mae Pwiuniuwan me Erhai Soaw Kapwiung
Iwe Jesus a fioangei ngaeniir rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun eew fioangon awewe pwe repwe memmaeipin noa rhag oanongaen oat nge resoapw mwetekkaein fangetae.
“Eno erhai soaw apwiung noan eew aepinoamw nge ese mesagiu Deus nge ese pwan aesirowuur aeremas.
Noan aepinoamw we nge epwan no erhai rhooapwut a mae pwiuniuwan, nge esooaw ikkitto rhag reen pwe epwe tipaengi nge a aengaeni pwe, ‘Tipaengiaei me reer rhooan appaniuwaen ngaeniaei.’
A ssiunaei aaen soaw apwiung we ese mwerhaen tipaengi rhooapwut we, nge enoa mwirin nge a maengiy nong rhag noan tipan pwe, ‘Inamwo ikka ise mesagiu Deus aere aesirowu aeremas,

iwe nge iga rhooapwut een a soaw ikkitto rhag angiurhiuwaei, iwe ipwene feeori ngaeni meeta na e tipaeni. Ngaere ise feeori ngaeni nge ina epwe ikkitto rhag angiurhiuwaei toori aaei sipegin aerhigerhig noa.’ ”
Iwe Soamwoon a pwan iura pwe, “Oaw aiussaening ngaeni meeta soaw apwiung aenneew we a iura.
Iwe Deus esoapw faer ppaeniir aeremas kkena a finiir iga ra sessaeng ngaeni rhag nee pwoong me nee raaen pwe epwe tipaengiir? Oaw niuwaennei nge epwe mmwaei aan tipaengiir?

Ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe Deus epwe mwetekkaei aan oayoow ngaeniir minikkena iir re tipaeni. Iwe oaw niuwaennei pwe mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas epwe weri tiwegin me wooan soanop reen oatonoa epwe sefaaeneto?”
Fioang Awewen Erhai Pharisee me Erhai Rhooan Iyoiyon Tax
Jesus a pwan fioangei awewe een ngaeniir aeremas kka re maengiy pwe iir regacch noa memmweer aaemweoi iwe nge oanongeer aeremas re sessoan tiw faer.
“Nonno noa wooar riiurhai mwaaen renoa noan Temple we pwe repwe noa maeipin; erhai Pharisee nge erhai rhooan iyoiyon tax.

Pharisee we a noa imweoi noa pwe a maeipin nge a iura pwe, ‘Wa aerhigerhig Deus pwe ngaang ise rhegoaw, ise oatupwutupw, me maiur ngaeni pwiuniuwaen erhai, taeppeer aeremas kka aaemweoi. Wa aerhigerhig pwe ngaang ise taeppen rhooan iyoiyon tax na eno iginaan.
Ngaang ise mwongo noan riiuraaen noan eew week, nge iya fang ngaeniug giniginin eew me reen seig me reen oanongan noa meeta paniuwaei.’
Nge rhooan iyoiyon tax we e iu me itaaw noa nge ese mmwen mwo nge epwe fattae weei naaeng, a gaen tugutuguw ne aiungan nge a gaen iura pwe, ‘Deus, faayeowaei, ngaang erhai man monofit!’ ”

Jesus a iura pwe, “Ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe rhooan iyoiyon tax naan nge saapw Pharisee naan minne enoa nee iimw nge e mwamwaai me noan sapweoiniun Deus. Pwe iyo na e aetaegiasa tae epwe sessoanotiw, nge iyo na epwe oasossonaetiw epwe taegias tae.”
Jesus a Maeipinaar Wonigaet Mwittig
Aaemweoi aeremas re pwigito naiiur wonigaet mwittig pwe Jesus epwe iseni tae paiun wooar. Rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra weriir nge ra soong ngaeniir reen miniwe refeeori,
nge Jesus a faingiir aetekkewe nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Fangeto aetekkena reei, nge oawsoapw aiugiiur, pwe minna Mweoiun Deus ina aar aeremas kka reweer wonigaet.
Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe iyo na ese aetiwa Mweoiun Deus taeppen erhai wonigaet, nge esoapw toonong noan.”
Erhai Mwaaen Naiwiis
Erhai soamwooniir Jews a aeiineow Jesus pwe, “Sinsei mwamwaai, meeta ipwe feeori nge epwe yo ngaeniaei menaw na esooar iaenin?”
Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Meeta wo iura pwe i mwamwaai reen?” Esooar erhai ne e mwamwaai pwe aeggaen Deus rhag.
Wo giuneei anniug kkewe: wosoapw ffeeor manetemwaai, wosoapw nni aeremas, wosoapw mwoarho, wosoapw oatupwutupw tae kkepas wooan erhai, aesirowuur semoamw me inoamw.
Mwaaen we a paniuwaeni pwe, “Saengi rhag nee nipwaen wonigaeteei nge ngaang i tapweei oanongaen oasoapwosoapw kkeei.”

Igiwe Jesus a rongorong miniwe nge a aengaeni pwe, “E rhiuwen no eew minne wopwe feeori. Wonoa ameow noa oanongaen pisaegimw nge wa fang senaapian ngaeniir rhooa affayeo, ina nge epwe yor wiinoamw me wooai naaeng. Iwe wa itto wopwe itto tapweaei.”
Igiwe mwaaen we a rongorong miniwe a igin aenneew tipan, pwe igiwe iiy erhai man naiwiis.
Jesus a weri pwe a aenneew tipan nge a iura pwe, “Ifa mwo waeiraesin aar rhooakka re pisaegisaeg repwe toonong noan minna Mweoiun Deus!
Egin mererhaeg aaen erhai camel epwe toonong noan ngetaen efoarh oaguwa, me mmwaen aaen erhai mwaaen pisaegisaeg epwe toonong noan minna Mweoiun Deus.”
Rhooa kkewe re rongorong miniwe ra aeiineo pwe, “Iwe, iyo rhag epwe mmwenen menaw?”
Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Minikkena ese mmwen ngaeniir aeremas nge emmwen ngaeni Deus.”
Peter a iura pwe, “Pipiiy! Aemaem aeiya nigiti pwugusaemmaem nge aeiya itto tapweog.”
Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi pwe aere erhai e siusaengi imwan, aere pwiuniuwan, aere pwiin, aere seman aere inan, aere naiun pwe faaen itaen minna Mweoiun Deus,
ina epwe gin temoag minne epwe pwigi reen oate igina, nge noan oatona epwe itto epwe pwan pwigi menaw na esooar iaenin.”
Aeinuwaen Aaen Jesus Aepesa Aan Maenoa

Jesus a paeniir noa rhooan akkiuneo kkewe seig me riiurhai a aengaeniir pwe, “Oaw aiussaening! Sipwene noa Jerusalem nge oanongaen meeta kkewe profeta kkewe re iura pwe wunuunun mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas ina epwene nnetaen wen.
Repwene iseni nong nee paiiur Gentiles, ina repwene aeni aegekkaei, me aessaewa, nge re oattuffa.
Repwene wirhiy nge reniiy noa, mwirin enuuw raaen nge a menaw sefaaen tae.”
Nge rhooan akkiuneo kkewe naiun nge rese metefaaegini minikkewe; pwe faan kkepas kkewe nge emwoan saengiir, iwe rese metefaaegini meeta kkewe Jesus e aepesa.
Jesus a Aeffetanoa Mesaen Erhai Mwaaen Parh
Jesus a aekkaerepa to Jericho, igiwe erhai mwaaen parh e mooaton wenepeigin aan nge e tittingoar noa rhag.
Igiwe a rongorong aar rhooanap we itto faaeraeg noa me oaron, nge a aeiineeor pwe, “Meeta eei?”
Ra aengaeni pwe, “Jesus re Nazareth iye epwe faaeraeg na me igeei.”
Mwaaen we aekkepwas noa, “Jesus, Naiun David, faayeowaei!”
Aeremas kkewe reno mmwan ra soong ngaeni pwe epwe anniug noa. Nge egius mwo nge oatomoga noa aan iyaekkepwas, “Naiun David, faayeowaei!”
Jesus a iug noa nge a akkiuneo pwe repwe pwigito man masparh we reen. Igiwe a arapeto nge Jesus a aeiineow pwe,
“Meeta wa tipaeni pwe ipwe feeori ngaeniug?” Nge a paniuwaeni pwe, “Soawumwaer! Ngaang i mwerhaen ipwe weriwer sefaaen.”
Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Iwe fanoa pwe wopwe weriwer! Oamw niugiuniug a aecchipwoag.”
Iwe rhag nge wonowe a ffatenoa mesan, iwe a tapweei Jesus iwe a itto fang aaen Deus aerhigerhig. Igiwe rhooanap we ra weri miniwe ra aepingepinga Deus.
